summary: CINCINNATI, September 15, 2026--The Health Collaborative (THC) announced a $150,000 investment from Covista to expand healthcare career exploration opportunities for middle and high school students across Greater Cincinnati.

title: Chamberlain University Names Jason Dunne Chief Academic Officer
summary: CHICAGO, September 14, 2026--Chamberlain University, a Covista institution and the nation's largest school of nursing, today announced Jason Dunne, DNP, MBA, MN, RN, as its next Chief Academic Officer, effective Sept. 14, 2026. Dunne will report to Amelia Manning, President, Chamberlain University, and will lead academic strategy, faculty development and curriculum across the university’s campuses and online programs nationwide, serving approximately 40,000 students.

title: Chamberlain University to Open Nashville Campus; Now Accepting Applications for January 2027 Cohort
summary: NASHVILLE, September 09, 2026--Chamberlain University, America's largest school of nursing and a Covista (NYSE: CVSA) institution, today announced it will open a new campus in Nashville, Tennessee, its first location in the state. The campus continues Chamberlain's national expansion strategy to address the U.S. healthcare workforce shortage and will offer day, evening and weekend class options, giving students more flexible opportunities to pursue a nursing degree. title: Chamberlain University Opens 25th Campus Nationwide, Bringing New Nursing Talent Pipeline to Cincinnati
summary: CINCINNATI, August 20, 2026--Chamberlain University, the nation's largest school of nursing and a Covista institution, cut the ribbon today on its 25th campus nationwide, bringing a new source of nurses to Cincinnati as the first cohort of students prepares to begin classes Aug. 31. The institution marked the occasion with another first: awarding its inaugural Future Healthcare Hero BSN Scholarship, covering the full cost of a Cincinnati resident’s Chamberlain University nursing degree.
